steps.en: System sends the company UEN to the registry
steps.id: Sistem mengirim UEN perusahaan ke registry
steps.why_en: The job calls a data hub, not confirmed to be DOS, and is switched off in production settings.
steps.why_id: Job memanggil data hub yang belum terkonfirmasi sebagai DOS, dan dimatikan di setelan produksi.

steps.en: System receives and stores the latest registered address
steps.id: Sistem menerima dan menyimpan alamat terdaftar terbaru
steps.why_en: The address is stored but overwritten each run and only runs if the job is enabled.
steps.why_id: Alamat disimpan tetapi ditimpa tiap run dan hanya jalan bila job aktif.

steps.en: System compares it with the address the reminder was sent to
steps.id: Sistem membandingkannya dengan alamat tujuan reminder
steps.why_en: No comparison of old and new address exists anywhere in the code.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada perbandingan alamat lama dan baru di code mana pun.

steps.en: Officer gets the address result in a report
steps.id: Staf mendapat hasil alamat dalam laporan
steps.why_en: The address report builder is never called by any schedule or screen.
steps.why_id: Pembuat laporan alamat tidak pernah dipanggil oleh jadwal atau layar mana pun.
